docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The first volume of Dutt’s history of ancient Indian civilisation from the Veda, the epics and the law books (Calcutta, 1889). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: History Of Civilization In Ancient India Vol.1 · Dutt, Romesh Chunder · 1889, 376 scanned pages. Published 1889; Romesh Chunder Dutt died 1909; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
